messages:
toni: quick heads-up 1: premerge SAST started failing after a keystore IAM cleanup. CI shows KMS decrypt denied for SARIF fixtures, blocking a handful of PRs. anyone who rolled keystore perms?

lee: that was me. tightened a binding to enforce least-privilege. i missed the pipeline SA (scanner-ci@).

sam: can you paste the CI error? want to confirm it's KMS:Decrypt and not uploader impersonation.

toni: snippet: 
```
ERROR: fixture decrypt failed
cause: cloudkms.googleapis.com KMS.Decrypt permission denied for projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/sarif-fixtures
uploader: exit 1
```

lee: yep KMS:Decrypt. i'll roll a short-lived grant instead of full revert.

run-bot: ephemeral grant created: id=GR-3201 principal=serviceAccount:scanner-ci@redwood expires=2026-03-01T12:14:00Z role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter

toni: re-running blocked jobs now while we patch infra. please attach audit diff to the postmortem. sec-bot, can you capture the IAM audit ID?

sec-bot: audit event detected: principal=lee@redwood action=iam.setIamPolicy resource=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ci timestamp=2026-03-01T11:34:12Z audit_id=AL-20260301-1134. linked grant GR-3201.

sam: long-term fixes: 1) require a keystore-smoke job that performs a KMS decrypt when any keyring or service-account binding changes; 2) update SARIF collector to compute fingerprint fallback (normalized message + path + 3-line snippet hash) so missing uploads don't drop suppressions; 3) add `approval:security` label for keystore IAM diffs.

lee: infra PR open: infra#912 adds explicit binding for scanner-ci SA, the smoke job, and a premerge gate. reviewers: sam, toni.

toni: thanks. postmortem should include timeline, audit_id AL-20260301-1134, grant id GR-3201, infra PR link, and action items. marking incident mitigated while infra#912 merges.

sec-bot: incident ticket created SEC-2026-031 severity=low-medium. evidence: AL-20260301-1134, GR-3201, infra#912.
